description: Energy Resources - eReliability Outages - PUBLIC is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This dataset contains the Monthly Outage Report export from American Public Power Association’s (APPA’s) eReliability software for the City of Mesa’s electric utility. This version redacts addresses of individuals with outages, substation facility and circuit names, and the name of the individual reporting the outage (may be an individual's name or address). Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are electricity outages, electric power failures. The portal shows 2024-08-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
